[[File:Sentient Jewel of the Furious.png|thumb|right|300px|One of the Sentient Jewels]]
Sentient Jewels contain the essence of sentience that is used to create a [[Sentient Weapon]].

A Sentient Jewel is not the same as a [[Sentient Weapon/Filigrees|Filigree]], but is a prerequisite for adding those to a weapon.
